items.title: 〈焦點股〉中興電上半年EPS 4.5元創同期高 價量齊揚站回季線
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Zhongxing Electric’s H1 EPS of NT$4.5 Sets Seasonal High as Price and Volume Surge to Reclaim Quarterly Trendline
paras: 中興電 (1513-TW) 受惠台電強韌電網計畫及 AI 需求暢旺，上半年稅後純益受惠台電強韌電網計畫及 AI 需求暢旺，上半年稅後純益 22.24 億元，年增逾 2 成，每股純益 4.5 元，續創歷史同期新高，激勵中興電今 (12) 日價量齊揚，站回季線。
中興電今天早盤以 161.5 元開高走高，盤中最高漲至 168 元，截至午盤，股價暫報 167 元，漲逾 4%，同步收復 5 日線、季線與半年線，成交量超過 6000 張。三大法人連續 2 個交易日買超，合計買超 605 張。
中興電第二季營收 75.33 億元，季增 16.06%，年增 6.03%；毛利率 28.44%，季增 2.46 個百分點，年增 3.76 個百分點；營益率 20.05%，季增 1.51 個百分點，年增 2.87 個百分點；稅後純益 12.68 億元，季增 35%，年增 2.64%，每股純益 2.56 元。
中興電累計今年上半年營收 140.24 億元，年增 3.48%；毛利率 27.3%，年增 2.26 個百分點；營益率 19.35%，年增 1.43 個百分點；稅後純益 22.24 億元，年增 22.2%，每股 4.5 元。
中興電今年成長動能除來自台電強韌電網計畫，也受惠離岸風電、半導體產業擴廠，以及 AIDC 需求暢旺，整體展望正向。目前在手訂單規模超過 400 億元，部分訂單能見度看至 2031 年，今年目標新增 200 至 250 億元，力拚全年營收年增雙位數。
paras_en: Zhongxing Electric (1513‑TW) benefited from Taipower’s resilient grid program and strong AI demand, posting a first‑half after‑tax profit of NT$2.224 billion, up more than 20% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$4.5 – a new historical high for the same period. The results spurred the stock to rally today (the 12th), with price and volume both climbing and the price moving back above the quarterly moving average.

The stock opened the morning session at NT$161.5 and rose higher, reaching a intraday high of NT$168. By the midday session the price was at NT$167, up more than 4%, simultaneously retaking the 5‑day, quarterly and half‑year moving averages, with trading volume exceeding 6,000 lots. The three major institutional investors posted net buying for the second consecutive trading day, buying a total of 605 lots.

In the second quarter, Zhongxing Electric recorded revenue of NT$7.533 billion, up 16.06% quarter‑over‑quarter and 6.03% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 28.44%, a quarterly increase of 2.46 percentage points and a yearly increase of 3.76 points; operating margin was 20.05%, up 1.51 points quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.87 points year‑over‑year; after‑tax profit was NT$1.268 billion, up 35% quarter‑over‑quarter and 2.64% year‑over‑year, translating to earnings per share of NT$2.56.

For the first half of the year, Zhongxing Electric’s cumulative revenue reached NT$14.024 billion, a 3.48% year‑over‑year increase; gross margin stood at 27.3%, up 2.26 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating margin was 19.35%, up 1.43 points year‑over‑year; after‑tax profit totaled NT$2.224 billion, up 22.2% year‑over‑year, or NT$4.5 per share.

The company’s growth momentum this year stems not only from Taipower’s resilient grid program but also from offshore wind projects, semiconductor plant expansions, and robust AIDC demand, giving it a positive outlook. It currently holds orders exceeding NT$40 billion, with some contracts visible through 2031. The target is to add NT$20‑25 billion of new orders this year, aiming for double‑digit revenue growth for the full year.

items.title: 奇瑞變成全球第九！全球十大車廠 中國搶佔三席
items.title_en: Chery Becomes Global Ninth! China Grabs Three Seats in Global Top Ten Automakers
paras: 2026 年夏天，全球汽車產業的牌桌上，終於迎來了屬於中國的高光時刻。
老牌自主車企奇瑞 (09973-HK) ，今年強勢躋身全球十大車企行列，並力壓美國福特 (F-US) ，排名第九位。奇瑞終於端端正正地坐上了全球汽車產業「主桌」。
全球十大車企榜單，第一次同時出現三家中國車企——比亞迪 (002594-CN) 、吉利 (00175-HK) 、奇瑞。全球百年汽車格局，就此重塑。
1. 中國汽車銷量，17 年全球第一
乘聯會秘書長崔東樹發文，稱中國汽車市場對世界汽車市場影響力極其巨大。
2016 年至 2022 年，中國汽車在全球汽車市場的比重在 30% 左右。從 2021 年開始，中國汽車乘著新能源車的東風迅速崛起，份額逐年攀升。
根據世界汽車組織統計數據，2025 年全球汽車銷量 9,689 萬輛。其中中國汽車銷量 3,435 萬輛，比重高達 35.4%。
這是中國汽車銷量規模連續第三年，保持在 3,000 萬輛以上，並連續第十七年位居全球第一。
當然，有人會說這裡的「中國汽車」涵蓋了合資品牌的數量，並不全是中國品牌的銷量。
事實上，就算只計算中國品牌車企銷量，同樣也已經是全球第一。
數據顯示，2025 年中國汽車品牌在全球市場的累計銷量達到 2,700 萬輛，增長約 10%，歷史上首次超越日本車企（銷量約 2,500 萬輛），全球第一。
這是自 2000 年以來，日本車企首次失去全球銷量冠軍寶座，為全球汽車產業格局重大轉變。
2. 全球十大車企，中國搶佔三席
進入 2026 年，中國汽車愈發強勢，這一點從全球十大車企格局巨變中，就可以明顯地看出來。
過去幾十年，中國車企別說躋身全球十大車企行列了，就算在中國國內進入前十，都是值得大書特書的事情。
直到 2023 年，比亞迪爆賣 302 萬輛，代表中國車企首次躋身全球十大汽車製造商之列。2024 年，吉利集團熱銷 334 萬輛，也進入全球十大車企行列。
至此，全球十大車企中，中國車企佔據兩個席位。
今年上半年，中國汽車再傳喜訊。上半年，奇瑞集團全球銷量份額達到 4.1%，成為全球十大車企之一，並力壓福特，排名第九。
另外，比亞迪份額 4.8%，位居第六；吉利集團份額 4.6%，排名第七。
全球銷量前十車企中，首次同時出現三家中國自主品牌汽車企業。美國也佔三席，日本有兩席，韓德各一席。
那張曾被歐美日韓霸佔了上百年的主桌，終於被中國搶佔了三席。
3. 奇瑞加速度，出口銷量稱王
過去幾年，奇瑞的銷量增速很猛。2020 年，奇瑞銷量只有 73 萬輛。
2021 年，奇瑞銷量勁增 32%，但還不到百萬輛，只有 96 萬輛。2022 年破百萬輛至 123 萬輛，2023 年又暴增至 188 萬輛。
2024 年，奇瑞大爆發，銷量一舉達到 260 萬輛。2025 年，奇瑞銷量又進一步增至 280 萬輛。
僅僅只用了五年時間，奇瑞銷量就增長了近四倍。進入 2026 年，奇瑞更進一步躋身全球十大車企行列。
與銷量增長速度相比，奇瑞的銷量結構和汽車出口更值得關注。
2025 年，奇瑞海外銷量 134 萬輛，在總銷量中的比重接近一半，連續 23 年位居中國品牌汽車出口第一。
進入 2026 年，奇瑞海外銷量更猛，7 月份出口 202,533 輛，較去年同期大增 70.1%，成為中國首個單月出口突破 20 萬輛的中國車企。
海外銷量在總銷量中的比重超過 73%，意味著海外市場對奇瑞而言，已經不是中國國內銷量之外的補充，而是決定整體增長速度的核心市場。
paras_en: This summer, the global automotive industry's table finally saw a highlight moment for China.

Old-fashioned independent automaker Chery (09973-HK), has strongly entered the global top ten automaker list this year, and has surpassed American Ford (F-US), ranking ninth. Chery has finally taken its rightful place at the global automotive industry's "main table".

The global top ten automaker list has, for the first time, simultaneously featured three Chinese automakers - BYD (002594-CN), Geely (00175-HK), and Chery. The global 100-year automotive landscape has been reshaped.
1. China's automotive sales, 17 years global first
The Secretary-General of the China Automobile Association, Cui Dongshu, wrote that the Chinese automotive market has had an extremely huge impact on the world automotive market.

From 2016 to 2022, China's automotive share in the global automotive market was around 30%. From 2021 onwards, China's automotive market has rapidly risen, driven by new energy vehicles, with its share increasing year by year.

According to the data from the World Automotive Organization, in 2025, the global automotive sales will reach 96.89 million units. Among them, China's automotive sales will reach 34.35 million units, with a share of 35.4%.
This is the third consecutive year that China's automotive sales have maintained over 30 million units, and the 17th consecutive year that China has ranked first in the world.
Of course, some people will say that the "Chinese automotive" here includes joint-venture brands, and not all of them are Chinese brands' sales.
In fact, even if only Chinese brand automakers' sales are counted, they are still the global first.

The data shows that in 2025, China's automotive brands will have a cumulative sales of 27 million units in the global market, with a growth of about 10%, and for the first time, surpassing Japanese automakers (sales of about 25 million units), and ranking first in the world.
This is the first time since 2000 that Japanese automakers have lost their global sales crown, marking a major shift in the global automotive industry landscape.
2. Global top ten automakers, China grabs three seats
Entering 2026, China's automotive industry has become increasingly powerful, and this can be seen from the massive changes in the global top ten automaker list.
In the past few decades, Chinese automakers have not even entered the global top ten automaker list, let alone in China's domestic market.

Until 2023, BYD sold 3.02 million units, marking the first time that Chinese automakers have entered the global top ten automaker list. In 2024, Geely Group sold 3.34 million units, also entering the global top ten automaker list.
By then, Chinese automakers had occupied two seats in the global top ten automaker list.

This year's first half, China's automotive industry has brought more good news. In the first half of the year, Chery Group's global sales share reached 4.1%, becoming one of the global top ten automakers, and surpassing Ford, ranking ninth.
In addition, BYD's share was 4.8%, ranking sixth, and Geely Group's share was 4.6%, ranking seventh.

For the first time, the global top ten automakers have simultaneously featured three Chinese independent brand automotive enterprises. The United States also occupies three seats, Japan has two seats, and South Korea has one seat.
That table, which had been occupied by Europe, America, Japan, and South Korea for over a hundred years, has finally been seized by China.
3. Chery accelerates, export sales reign supreme
In recent years, Chery's sales growth has been very rapid. In 2020, Chery's sales were only 730,000 units.

In 2021, Chery's sales surged by 32%, but were still below 1 million units, at 960,000 units. In 2022, Chery's sales broke 1 million units to 1.23 million units, and in 2023, Chery's sales surged to 1.88 million units.
In 2024, Chery had a major breakthrough, with sales reaching 2.6 million units. In 2025, Chery's sales further increased to 2.8 million units.
In just five years, Chery's sales have grown by nearly four times. Entering 2026, Chery has further entered the global top ten automaker list.
Compared to sales growth speed, Chery's sales structure and automotive exports are more worth paying attention to.
In 2025, Chery's overseas sales were 1.34 million units, accounting for nearly half of its total sales, and for the 23rd consecutive year, Chery has ranked first in China's brand automotive exports.

Entering 2026, Chery's overseas sales have become even more rapid, with 202,533 units exported in July, a year-on-year increase of 70.1%, becoming China's first automaker to have a single month's exports exceed 2 million units.

Overseas sales accounted for over 73% of Chery's total sales, meaning that the overseas market has become the core market that determines Chery's overall growth speed, rather than just a supplement to domestic sales.

items.title: 輝達化解AI市場一大疑慮 分析師：可降低「循環交易」風險
items.title_en: Nvidia Resolves AI Market Concerns, Analysts Say
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，部分投資人一直擔心輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 與客戶之間緊密的財務關係，但分析師認為，輝達最新宣布的合作夥伴關係，應能暫時消除這些疑慮。
輝達日前宣布，已就「獨立運算融資」成立策略合作夥伴關係，規模超過 5,000 億美元，目的是長期支援人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設的發展。輝達表示，包括阿波羅全球管理 (Apollo Global Management)、黑石 (Blackstone) 及高盛 (Goldman Sachs) 在內的 6 家公司，將提供第三方資金。
摩根士丹利分析師 Joseph Moore 在給客戶的報告中表示，輝達主要利用第三方資金投資 AI 工廠，也就是大規模資料中心，「理應可以緩解市場對循環交易的疑慮」。
輝達執行長黃仁勳周一在 X 發文表示，公司可以視個案情況，為投資案提供最高 25% 的資金。
Moore 表示，在這樣的投資比例下，「具備專業能力的第三方投資團體」將掌握決策權，這應有助於消除市場對相關交易「純粹受到循環性動機驅動」的疑慮。
Moore 也認為，考量輝達在相關交易所處 AI 生態系統中扮演重要推動者的角色，這對輝達而言顯然具潛在正面效益。
輝達在新聞稿中表示，這些融資平台將使其晶片及其他 AI 產品「成為可投資的資產類別」，並創造「與長期使用量有關的營收」。Moore 表示，這意味著相關交易將納入輝達先前宣布的營收分成模式，讓公司「能夠從可能 100% 持續使用輝達產品的客戶身上推動營收成長」。
美國銀行分析師 Vivek Arya 也持相似看法，認為這些策略合作對輝達而言正面，因為「負擔由金融機構承擔」，而不是輝達的資產負債表。
Arya 指出，要讓運算能力被視為可投資資產，其「剩餘價值必須維持」，而輝達的晶片具備這項條件。他在報告中指出，輝達的 GPU 具可互換性，可被不同 AI 開發商使用，而其 CUDA 軟體則能延長晶片的使用壽命。因此，他認為輝達 GPU 的轉售及租賃價格仍可維持在高檔。
Arya 表示，「這個平台鞏固了 CUDA 護城河，同時將資本風險從輝達身上轉移出去。在我們看來，這是個結構性看多的布局。」但他也表示，新合作夥伴關係所促成的交易，仍需要來自真正客戶的實際資金。
Arya 認為，輝達本月底的財報電話會議，可能為華爾街及投資人提供「亟需的信心」，以了解公司未來在供應商融資中的角色。這類融資會侵蝕輝達的自由現金流。在他看來，這些資金「或許可以更有效的投入目前估值大幅偏低的股票」。
輝達股價周二小幅收低，至每股 217.50 美元。
摩根士丹利的 Moore 表示，輝達為新興雲端服務商及主權 AI 提供的後盾支持，他認為涉及信用風險，將成為「輝達股票下一個重大爭論點」。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that some investors have been concerned about Nvidia's (NVDA-US) close financial ties with its customers, but analysts believe that the company's latest announcement of a strategic partnership should alleviate these concerns.

Nvidia recently announced that it has established a strategic partnership for 'independent compute financing' with a scale of over $5 trillion, aiming to provide long-term support for the development of artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

Morgan Stanley analyst Joseph Moore stated in a report to clients that Nvidia mainly uses third-party funds to invest in AI factories, which are large-scale data centers, and 'should be able to alleviate market concerns about circular trading'.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in a tweet on Monday that the company can provide up to 25% of the investment for each case.

Moore stated that with this investment ratio, 'professional third-party investment groups' will have decision-making power, which should help to eliminate market concerns that related transactions are driven solely by circular motives.
Moore also believes that considering Nvidia's role as a key driver in the AI ecosystem, this has obvious positive implications for the company.

Nvidia stated in a press release that these financing platforms will make its chips and other AI products 'investable asset classes' and create 'revenue related to long-term usage'. Moore stated that this means that related transactions will be included in Nvidia's previously announced revenue-sharing model, allowing the company to 'drive revenue growth from customers who may use Nvidia products continuously for 100%'.

US Bank analyst Vivek Arya also shares a similar view, believing that these strategic partnerships are positive for Nvidia because 'the burden is borne by financial institutions, not Nvidia's balance sheet'.

Arya pointed out that for computational power to be viewed as an investable asset, 'its residual value must be maintained', and Nvidia's chips meet this condition. He stated in the report that Nvidia's GPUs have interchangeability, can be used by different AI developers, and its CUDA software can extend the lifespan of the chips. Therefore, he believes that Nvidia's GPU resale and rental prices can still maintain a high level.

Arya stated, 'This platform solidifies the CUDA moat, and transfers capital risk from Nvidia. In our view, this is a structural bull case.' However, he also stated that the transactions promoted by the new partnership relationship still require actual capital from real customers.

Arya believes that Nvidia's earnings call on the last day of the month may provide 'much-needed confidence' for Wall Street and investors to understand the company's future role in supplier financing. This type of financing will erode Nvidia's free cash flow. In his view, these funds 'may be invested more effectively in stocks that are currently significantly undervalued'.
Nvidia's stock price fell slightly on Tuesday to $217.50 per share.
Morgan Stanley's Moore stated that Nvidia's support for emerging cloud service providers and sovereign AI will be 'the next major controversy point for Nvidia stock'.

items.title: 歐洲「愛國者」飛彈庫存告急 烏克蘭防空能力面臨考驗
paras: 隨著俄羅斯發動新一輪攻勢，歐洲正緊急尋找更多「愛國者」防空飛彈，以援助防空能力日益吃緊的烏克蘭。伊朗戰爭已令美國飛彈庫存承壓，歐洲一些主要支持烏克蘭的國家也表示，能夠捐出的防空飛彈所剩無幾。
「過去幾個月，俄羅斯一周發射的飛彈數量，比合作夥伴幾個月內提供給我國的數量還多。」烏克蘭前國防部長米哈伊洛 · 費多羅夫上周表示。
烏克蘭國防部稱，7 月俄軍發射的 195 枚彈道飛彈中，烏克蘭防空系統僅攔截 29 枚，另有 40 枚未能命中目標。
德國是烏克蘭最大軍事援助國之一，此前已經向烏克蘭提供「愛國者」防空系統及防空飛彈。但如今，德國必須在滿足烏克蘭日益緊迫的需求與維持自身最低庫存、履行北約（NATO）承諾之間尋找平衡。
「我們確實已經接近極限。」德國國防部高階官員、准將於爾根 · 施勒德爾在上月柏林舉行的一場論壇上表示，「我們也必須確保自身安全。」
這給波蘭、西班牙、希臘等擁有「愛國者」飛彈庫存的國家帶來壓力。當前短缺主要集中在「愛國者」PAC-3 和 PAC-2 防空飛彈上，而這兩款飛彈是烏克蘭少數能夠有效攔截高速俄羅斯彈道武器的防禦手段之一。
針對無人機和巡弋飛彈，烏克蘭還可以使用其他防空系統，而且這些系統通常成本更低。
烏克蘭正加快研發本土「Freyja」攔截器，但這一反彈道飛彈系統仍需要進一步投入資金，展開工程研發和測試。
美國總統川普成為烏克蘭能否獲得更多防空飛彈的關鍵人物。大多數 PAC-3 防空飛彈由美國生產，因此相關銷售以及生產協議都需要經過白宮決定。
一名烏克蘭高階官員表示，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基上月與川普會面時主要議題就是「愛國者」防空飛彈。
美伊戰爭爆發，美國飛彈庫存幾乎已經耗盡。川普開始將重點轉向補充美國自身庫存。當被問及澤輪斯基要求提供更多「愛國者」飛彈時，川普表示：「我國自己也需要飛彈。」
這意味著在冬季到來之前，歐洲盟友再次承擔起尋找攔防空飛彈的緊迫任務。各國正在重新檢查自己的武器庫，也在相互打聽，尋找能夠儘快運抵烏克蘭的防空飛彈。

items.title: 蘋果App Store佣金戰再挫！法院駁回暫緩請求 24小時內交方案
items.title_en: Apple App Store Commission War Takes Another Hit! Court Rejects Request for Temporary Stay, Must Submit Proposal Within 24 Hours
paras: 蘋果與 Epic Games 長達多年的 App Store 訴訟再添新進展。美國加州北區聯邦地區法院法官 Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers 駁回蘋果 (AAPL-US) 要求暫緩相關費用程序的動議，意味蘋果必須繼續推進 App Store 外部支付交易佣金的方案制定，並在 24 小時內提交擬議費用、計算依據及相關證據。
這起爭議源自蘋果與 Epic Games 多年來的 App Store 反壟斷訴訟。Rogers 先前裁定，蘋果在法院要求其允許開發者引導使用者前往 App Store 以外付款後，仍針對透過外部連結完成的交易收取 27% 佣金，構成藐視法庭。蘋果其後針對該裁決提出上訴，美國最高法院已同意受理案件，而蘋果則希望在最高法院審理期間暫停下級法院的相關程序。
不過，Epic Games 反對暫緩，主張最高法院是否最終推翻或改變相關裁決，不應妨礙目前針對外部支付佣金的程序。Epic 在提交法院的文件中並指出，若暫緩動議遭駁回，蘋果已同意在 24 小時內提出其希望收取的費用方案，以及支持該方案的證據。
如今 Rogers 正式駁回蘋果的暫緩要求，代表案件將繼續在下級法院推進。蘋果接下來必須提出一套針對開發者透過外部連結完成交易的費用方案，並說明其計算方式及為何該方案應獲法院批准。
這場爭議的核心並非單純是佣金比例，而是蘋果究竟能否針對開發者將使用者導向外部支付系統的交易收費，以及如果可以，費用應該如何計算。美國第九巡迴上訴法院此前已認為蘋果可以收取一定費用，但應以蘋果因外部連結交易實際產生且合理必要的成本為基礎，案件因此重新交回 Rogers 法官處理。
蘋果此前在法院命令下允許開發者加入外部支付連結，但對相關交易收取 27% 佣金。Epic 則認為，這項安排實際上仍會削弱開發者使用第三方支付的誘因，因此持續要求蘋果放寬限制。法院先前進一步限制蘋果不得透過佣金或其他手段阻礙開發者引導使用者使用外部支付方式。
蘋果則認為，最高法院即將審理的上訴可能直接影響下級法院目前進行的費用計算，因此暫停程序可以避免法院與雙方投入大量資源後，最終因最高法院裁決而重新開始。蘋果也曾援引加州北區聯邦地區法院近期另一宗案件，主張當最高法院即將審理的法律問題可能影響下級法院案件時，法院已有暫緩程序的先例。
但法院此次並未接受蘋果的論點。根據目前程序安排，蘋果必須先提出具體費用方案，後續法院才會進一步檢視相關計算是否符合此前判決所確立的限制。

這場法律戰對蘋果的 App Store 商業模式具有重要意義。App Store 長期是蘋果服務業務的重要收入來源，蘋果通常針對 App 內數位商品及服務交易收取一定比例的佣金。蘋果公布的全球 App Store 資料顯示，其 App Store 生態系在 2024 年的帳單與銷售總額達 1.295 兆美元，其中超過 90% 的交易類型並不由蘋果收取佣金，但數位商品與服務交易仍是其重要商業模式之一。
另一方面，蘋果近期財報也已反映 App Store 相關政策變化帶來的影響。蘋果財務長 Kevan Parekh 此前表示，App Store 業務受到行動遊戲市場疲軟、部分國家 App Store 商業模式調整，以及美國法院針對外部連結交易的裁決影響；蘋果當季服務業務營收為 307 億美元，年增 12%，但仍低於市場預期。
對開發者而言，如果蘋果最終只能針對外部支付交易收取與實際成本掛鉤的費用，與傳統 App Store 佣金模式相比，開發者可保留的交易收入可能增加，第三方支付也可能更具經濟吸引力。反過來說，若蘋果最終能維持較高費率，App Store 既有的收入結構受到的衝擊則可能相對有限。
目前最高法院的審理將成為這場法律戰的另一個關鍵節點。最高法院預計在 10 月開始的新一個審理期處理蘋果相關上訴，而下級法院此次拒絕暫緩，意味兩條法律程序將可能並行推進。
因此，蘋果接下來 24 小時內提交的費用方案，將成為外界觀察 App Store 佣金制度下一步走向的重要文件。若法院認定蘋果提出的費用過高，可能進一步壓縮 App Store 在美國外部支付交易上的收入空間；若方案獲得認可，則將為蘋果在法院命令下重新建立外部支付收費模式提供依據。
paras_en: Apple's long-standing App Store lawsuit with Epic Games has taken another turn. US Northern District of California Federal Court Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers has rejected Apple's (AAPL-US) request to temporarily stay related fee proceedings, meaning Apple must continue to push forward with its proposal for commission rates on external payment transactions and submit a proposed fee, calculation basis, and related evidence within 24 hours.

This dispute stems from Apple's long-standing App Store antitrust lawsuit with Epic Games. Rogers previously ruled that Apple still charges a 27% commission on transactions completed through external links, despite allowing developers to direct users to external payment methods, constituting contempt of court. Apple subsequently appealed the ruling, and the US Supreme Court has agreed to hear the case, with Apple hoping to suspend lower court proceedings during the appeal.

However, Epic Games opposed the stay, arguing that the Supreme Court's potential decision to overturn or modify the previous ruling should not hinder the current proceedings on external payment commission rates. Epic pointed out in its court filings that if the stay request is rejected, Apple has agreed to submit its proposed fee and supporting evidence within 24 hours.

Now, Rogers has formally rejected Apple's stay request, representing that the case will continue in the lower court. Apple must subsequently submit a proposal for a fee structure on external payment transactions and explain its calculation method and why the proposal should be approved by the court.

The core of this dispute is not just the commission rate, but whether Apple can charge developers for directing users to external payment systems and, if so, how the fee should be calculated. The US Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals previously found that Apple can charge a fee, but it should be based on the actual costs incurred and necessary for Apple, and the case was remanded back to Rogers for further consideration.

Apple previously allowed developers to add external payment links, but still charged a 27% commission on related transactions. Epic argued that this arrangement would still discourage developers from using third-party payments, and continued to request that Apple relax its restrictions. The court further restricted Apple from using commissions or other means to hinder developers from directing users to external payment methods.

Apple argued that the Supreme Court's upcoming review of the appeal could directly impact the lower court's current fee calculation, and that a stay would avoid wasting court and party resources only to have the case start over due to the Supreme Court's decision. Apple also cited a recent case in the Northern District of California as precedent for granting a stay when a higher court's decision may impact a lower court case.

However, the court did not accept Apple's argument. According to the current procedure, Apple must first submit a specific fee proposal, and the court will then review the calculation to ensure it complies with the previous ruling's restrictions.

This legal battle has significant implications for Apple's App Store business model. The App Store has long been a crucial revenue source for Apple's services business, with Apple typically charging a commission on digital goods and services transactions. Apple's global App Store data shows that its ecosystem generated $1.295 trillion in billings and sales in 2024, with over 90% of transactions not involving Apple's commission, but digital goods and services remain an important part of its business model.

On the other hand, Apple's recent financial reports have reflected the impact of changes in App Store policies. Apple's CFO, Kevan Parekh, previously stated that App Store business was affected by the softness of the mobile gaming market, adjustments to App Store business models in some countries, and US court decisions on external link transactions; Apple's quarterly services revenue was $30.7 billion, up 12% year-over-year, but still below market expectations.

For developers, if Apple is ultimately only allowed to charge fees based on actual costs, the retained transaction income may increase, and third-party payments may become more economically attractive. Conversely, if Apple maintains a higher fee rate, the impact on App Store's existing revenue structure may be relatively limited.

The Supreme Court's review will become another critical juncture in this legal battle. The Supreme Court is expected to begin its new review period in October, and the lower court's rejection of the stay means that the two legal proceedings may proceed concurrently.

Therefore, Apple's proposed fee structure, to be submitted within 24 hours, will be an important document for observing the next steps in the App Store commission system. If the court finds Apple's proposed fee too high, it may further compress Apple's revenue space for external payment transactions in the US; if the proposal is approved, it will provide a basis for Apple to re-establish its external payment fee model under court order.

items.title: 日元到底有多弱？「豬排咖哩指數」算出1美元只值62日元
items.title_en: How Weak is the Yen? "Katsu Curry Index" Calculates 1 US Dollar Equals 62 Japanese Yen
paras: 紐約梅隆銀行（BNY Mellon）一名資深策略師，正透過日本平價美食「豬排咖哩」的價格，衡量日元究竟有多疲弱。在近期匯市干預效果逐漸消退之際，這項指標試圖更貼近日本民眾對日元貶值的實際感受。
該行策略師 Geoff Yu 建立「豬排咖哩指數」（Katsu Curry Index），作為「大麥克指數」（Big Mac Index）的替代指標。
他認為，與其比較各國漢堡價格，不如以豬排、米飯與咖哩組成的日式國民美食進行國際價格比較，更能反映日元貶值對日本民眾購買力的影響。
在週三 (12 日) 早晨的全球外匯市場中，一美元約可兌換 159.23 日元。然而，根據 Geoff Yu 將豬排咖哩價格所反映出的日元購買力納入計算，一美元其實僅能兌換 62.18 日元。
這顯示外匯市場嚴重低估了日元的價值。相較之下，基於跨國麥當勞漢堡價格的大麥克指數則指出，一美元應可兌換 80.30 日元。
Yu 表示：「如果目標是讓購買力與高所得國家看齊，這項指數顯示，日元必須大幅升值。」他的計算採用全球最大咖哩飯連鎖品牌 CoCo 壹番屋的價格資料，該品牌在全球約有 1,500 家門市。
日本與美國政府日前採取 15 年來最具規模的匯市干預行動，試圖將日元從兌美元近 40 年低點拉回，使日元成為全球外匯市場焦點。然而，日元此後已回吐干預帶來的約一半漲幅。
日元處於歷史低檔，不僅讓許多日本民眾出國旅遊與購買進口商品的成本大幅增加，隨著餐飲、服務及消費品價格上漲，日常生活支出也受到衝擊。
Yu 表示：「如果在日本吃一份豬排咖哩或一碗拉麵，都變得貴到令人難以負擔，要求政策轉向的聲音可能就會愈來愈大。」
以購買力平價為基礎的替代指數還有很多。例如，「大杯拿鐵指數」（Tall Latte Index）追蹤星巴克咖啡在全球各地的售價；「肯德基指數」（KFC Index）則是為了更準確衡量非洲地區的購買力平價而設計，因為大麥克在當地市場的普及程度相對較低。
paras_en: A senior strategist at New York Mellon Bank (BNY Mellon) is using the price of a Japanese comfort food, "Katsu Curry," to gauge the yen's weakness. As the impact of recent currency intervention begins to fade, this index aims to better reflect Japanese people's actual feelings about yen depreciation.
The strategist, Geoff Yu, created the "Katsu Curry Index" as an alternative to the "Big Mac Index."

He believes that comparing the prices of burgers in different countries is not as effective as comparing the prices of a Japanese national dish made of pork cutlet, rice, and curry to reflect the impact of yen depreciation on Japanese people's purchasing power.

In the global foreign exchange market on Wednesday morning (12th), one US dollar was equivalent to approximately 159.23 Japanese yen. However, according to Geoff Yu's calculation, which incorporates the purchasing power of Katsu Curry, one US dollar can only be exchanged for 62.18 Japanese yen.

This shows that the foreign exchange market has severely underestimated the value of the yen. In comparison, the Big Mac Index, based on the prices of McDonald's burgers across countries, suggests that one US dollar should be equivalent to 80.30 Japanese yen.

Yu said, "If the goal is to make purchasing power comparable to high-income countries, this index shows that the yen must appreciate significantly." His calculation uses the price data of CoCo Ichibanya, the world's largest curry rice chain, which has approximately 1,500 outlets globally.

The Japanese and US governments recently took the largest currency intervention in 15 years to try to bring the yen back from its near 40-year low against the US dollar, making the yen a focal point in the global foreign exchange market. However, the yen has since given back about half of the appreciation brought by the intervention.

The yen is at a historical low, not only increasing the cost of travel and imported goods for many Japanese people, but also affecting daily living expenses as food, service, and consumer goods prices rise.
Yu said, "If eating a Katsu Curry or a bowl of ramen in Japan becomes so expensive that it's hard to bear, the voices calling for a policy shift may become louder."

There are many alternative indices based on purchasing power parity, such as the "Tall Latte Index," which tracks the prices of Starbucks coffee in different locations, and the "KFC Index," designed to more accurately measure purchasing power parity in Africa, where McDonald's is less popular.

items.title: 吞Cursor後馬斯克猛攻企業AI代理！SpaceXAI推全天候「數位同事」Grok Bot
items.title_en: Musk Unleashes Enterprise AI Agent After Acquiring Cursor, Introduces SpaceXAI's Grok Bot
paras: SpaceX 旗下 AI 部門 SpaceXAI 周二 (11 日) 正式發佈企業級 AI 代理產品 Grok Bot，定位「全天候線上、能登入你的工具、像同事一樣完成實際工作」智慧團隊，距 SpaceX 以 600 億美元全股票交易收購 AI 編程工具 Cursor 僅約兩個月，標誌著馬斯克將 xAI 併入 SpaceX 後，把戰火從大模型基準燒向「辦公場景落地」。
Grok Bot 不是聊天框。每個 Bot 擁有獨立雲端運算環境，可登入使用者常用的 App、信箱與網站，跨應用程式操作、自主分配子任務，使用者關機也不中斷，只在需審核或決策時回報，多個 Bot 能互傳上下文、在群組聊天中自分工，用戶示範一次流程，它便記住偏好、隨合作次數進化。
SpaceXAI 透露，此原型已在內部銷售外呼、行銷、維運與漏洞修復中自發性擴散。
定價方面，團隊版每席每月 120 美元，個人版 200 美元，初期開放給 SuperGrok Heavy、Cursor Ultra 及 Cursor Premium Teams 用戶，企業客戶走候補名單，支援 macOS、Windows、Linux、iOS。
支撐產品的是一條併購 + 算力 + 模型的鏈條。馬斯克在上周二 (4 日)SpaceX 首個上市後財報電話會議上預告，Grok 4.6 將於本週登場，並將 SpaceX 歷年火箭、衛星、Starlink 工程資料灌入訓練集。
但戰場早已擁擠，Anthropic 有 Claude Cowork 與 Computer Use，OpenAI 讓 Codex 控管第三方應用、推 Workspace Agents。
Grok Bot 的差異化在「持久化數位同事」，不靠 API 預接，而用視覺 + 操作模擬真人用軟體，但權限、審計與開源模型資安爭議則是弱點。
分析人士認為，馬斯克把航太工程人才調去訓模型、用 Cursor 抓開發者行為數據、用 Colossus 超算壓成本，試圖把「算力—程式設計—辦公室代理」做成垂直棧；但高資本開支換來的 AI 收入仍伴隨巨額虧損，而代理自主登錄與業務系統，正把企業從前控制站起來。
paras_en: SpaceX's AI division, SpaceXAI, officially released its enterprise-level AI agent product, Grok Bot, on Tuesday (11th), positioning it as a 24/7 online, login-enabled tool that completes actual work like a team member. This comes just about two months after Musk acquired AI coding tool Cursor for $60 billion in an all-stock deal, marking a significant milestone in Musk's integration of xAI into SpaceX, shifting the focus from large model benchmarks to 'office scenario deployment'.

Grok Bot is not a chat box. Each bot has its own independent cloud computing environment, allowing users to log in to their commonly used apps, email, and websites, cross-app operations, autonomous task allocation, and users can shut down without interruption, only reporting when needed for review or decision-making. Multiple bots can exchange context, divide tasks in group chats, and users can demonstrate a process, and it will remember preferences and evolve with repeated collaboration.
SpaceXAI revealed that this prototype has been organically spreading in internal sales, marketing, operations, and vulnerability repair.

Pricing-wise, the team version is $120 per seat per month, while the personal version is $200. Initially, it will be opened to SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra, and Cursor Premium Teams users, with enterprise customers on a waiting list, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS.

The supporting product is a chain of mergers, computing power, and models. Musk previewed on last Tuesday's (4th) SpaceX's first public earnings call that Grok 4.6 would be released this week, and would be trained with SpaceX's historical rocket, satellite, and Starlink engineering data.
However, the battlefield is already crowded, with Anthropic's Claude Cowork and Computer Use, OpenAI's Codex controlling third-party applications, and pushing Workspace Agents.

Grok Bot's differentiation lies in 'persistent digital colleagues', not relying on API pre-integration, but using visual + operation simulation of human software, but permission, auditing, and open-source model security concerns are weaknesses.

Analysts believe that Musk has shifted aerospace engineering talent to train models, used Cursor to capture developer behavior data, and used Colossus supercomputing to reduce costs, trying to create a vertical stack of 'computing power - programming - office agent'; however, high capital expenditures accompanied by AI revenue still result in massive losses, and autonomous login and business systems are making enterprises rise from their former control centers.

items.title: 英特爾募資規模增至200億美元 為何對ASML來說是好消息？
items.title_en: Intel Raises Capital Raising to $200 Billion: Why It's Good News for ASML
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，英特爾 (Intel)(INTC-US) 計劃透過股票發行籌集 200 億美元，這對艾司摩爾 (ASML)(ASML-US) 及其他晶片製造設備業者而言是個好消息。
英特爾周一晚間表示，將股票發行規模從原先的 150 億美元提高至 200 億美元。公司計劃以每股 95 美元的價格發行 2.105 億股新股。
英特爾股價周二 (11 日) 收漲 0.2%，報 97.71 美元。周一公司首次公布募資計畫時，股價下跌 4.1%，收在 97.52 美元，當時公司市值約 4,920 億美元。
英特爾正利用股價大幅上漲的機會籌資。截至周二收盤，該股今年以來已上漲 165%，過去 12 個月大漲 348%。
市場自認知道英特爾這筆資金將流向何處：晶片製造設備。這對 ASML 而言是個好消息，因 ASML 生產製造先進晶片所需的微影設備。ASML ADR 股價周二收漲 3.8%，報 1,799.38 美元。
KeyBanc 分析師 Matt Bryson 在研究報告中寫道，「我們認為，此次募資符合英特爾擴大投資的方向，以支應目前增加的 CPU 需求，以及未來客製化 ASIC、晶圓代工及封裝等業務需求。因此，儘管股權稀釋對現有投資人而言不利，但需求訊號對英特爾、同業及資本設備供應商而言都是正面的。」
其他晶片製造設備業者，包括科林研發 (Lam Research)(LRCX-US)、KLA Corp(KLAC-US) 及應用材料 (Applied Materials)(AMAT-US) 周二股價也都上漲。
英特爾管理層在最近一次財報電話會議中表示，公司將 2026 年資本支出預估提高至超過 200 億美元，高於原先約 180 億美元，因公司正努力滿足產品需求持續上升的趨勢。
英特爾目前正大舉投資，希望目前的 18A 及未來的 14A 晶片製造製程能吸引外部客戶，進而抵銷晶圓代工部門每季數十億美元的虧損。
根據 FactSet 預估，英特爾今年的自由現金流預計將小幅呈現負值。2022 年至 2025 年間，累計自由現金流為負 440 億美元。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) plans to raise $200 billion through a stock offering, which is good news for ASML (ASML-US) and other semiconductor equipment makers.
Intel announced on Monday evening that it will increase the stock offering size from the original $150 billion to $200 billion. The company plans to issue 2.105 billion new shares at $95 per share.

Intel's stock price rose 0.2% on Tuesday (11th) to $97.71. On Monday, when the company first announced its fundraising plan, the stock price fell 4.1% to $97.52, and the company's market value was approximately $492 billion.
Intel is taking advantage of the significant increase in its stock price to raise capital. As of Tuesday's close, the stock has risen 165% this year and 348% over the past 12 months.

The market believes that Intel's funds will flow into semiconductor equipment, which is good news for ASML, as ASML produces microchip manufacturing equipment that requires advanced lithography equipment. ASML ADR stock price rose 3.8% on Tuesday to $1,799.38.

KeyBanc analyst Matt Bryson wrote in a research report, "We believe this fundraising is consistent with Intel's direction to expand investment to meet current and future CPU demand, as well as customized ASIC, wafer foundry, and packaging business needs. Although dilution is unfavorable to existing investors, the demand signal is positive for Intel, its peers, and capital equipment suppliers."
Other semiconductor equipment makers, including Lam Research (LRCX-US), KLA Corp (KLAC-US), and Applied Materials (AMAT-US), also saw their stock prices rise on Tuesday.

Intel's management team stated in its recent earnings conference call that the company's capital expenditure forecast for 2026 will exceed $200 billion, higher than the original estimate of around $180 billion, as the company is working to meet the trend of continuously increasing product demand.

Intel is currently investing heavily, hoping to attract external customers to its 18A and future 14A chip manufacturing processes, which will offset the significant quarterly losses of its wafer foundry business.
According to FactSet estimates, Intel's free cash flow is expected to be slightly negative this year. From 2022 to 2025, the cumulative free cash flow was negative $440 billion.

items.title_en: Richcore Sees 2% Revenue Growth, Maintains 50% Gross Margin
paras: 保護元件廠富致 (6642-TW) 表示，受惠工控、車用帶動，下半年營收可望維持高檔，將優於上半年，全年毛利率維持 50% 以上；法人估，富致今年營收至少成長 2 成起跳，獲利有機會近半股本。
富致上半年營收 3.21 億元，年增 14.85%、毛利率 51.50%，年增 5.44 個百分點、稅後純益 0.85 億元，年增 108%，每股純益 2.28 元；累計前 7 月營收 3.93 億元，年增 22.2%。
富致表示，公司布局聚焦四大市場，以營收比重來看，電動車 / 自駕車 32%、AI / 資料中心 32%、工控自動化 / 機器人 31%、能源 / 轉換及儲能 4%、其他 1%；目前公司在全球 PPTC 市場市佔率 7%，世界排行第三。
在 AI 及資料中心方面，富致鎖定邊緣 AI、企業端應用，客戶包含美系雲端服務商 (CSP)、AI 伺服器代工廠以及工業電腦廠；另外，因應 AI 高壓需求，富致也開發 277V、305V 產品，並布局 800V 高壓直流 (HVDC) 產品。
工控方面，富致表示，除了半導體設備外，還有機器人 / 機械手臂節點及通訊、工具機等，今年以來受惠工業自動化需求強勁；電動車則受惠美日韓車廠需求帶動，以及車用電子系統需求提升，均帶動相關產品出貨。
針對產品價格，富致表示，產品原物料成本比重約 3 成，今年以來金屬、PP 成本上漲 10-12%，今年上半年已經漲價 5-10%，下半年視原物料走勢調整，若匯率沒有太大的變化下，全年毛利率可以維持 50% 以上水準。
paras_en: Richcore (6642-TW) expects its revenue to remain high in the second half of the year, driven by growth in industrial control and automotive markets. The company's gross margin is expected to remain above 50%. Analysts estimate that Richcore's revenue will grow by at least 2% this year, with a potential profit of nearly half of its shareholders.

Richcore's revenue for the first half of the year was NT$3.21 billion, up 14.85% year-over-year, with a gross margin of 51.50%, up 5.44 percentage points year-over-year. Net profit was NT$850 million, up 108% year-over-year, with earnings per share of NT$2.28. Cumulative revenue for the first seven months was NT$3.93 billion, up 22.2% year-over-year.

Richcore has focused its business on four major markets, with revenue distribution as follows: electric vehicles and autonomous vehicles (32%), AI and data centers (32%), industrial control and automation (31%), energy and conversion (4%), and others (1%). The company currently has a 7% market share in the global PPTC market, ranking third in the world.

In the AI and data center market, Richcore is targeting edge AI and enterprise applications, with customers including US cloud service providers (CSP), AI server manufacturers, and industrial computer manufacturers. In response to the high demand for AI, Richcore has developed 277V and 305V products and is also laying out 800V high-voltage direct current (HVDC) products.

In the industrial control market, Richcore has indicated that it has products beyond semiconductor equipment, including robotic and mechanical arm nodes, communication tools, and machine tools. The company has benefited from strong demand for industrial automation this year, as well as demand from automotive manufacturers in the US, Japan, and South Korea, and increased demand for vehicle electronics systems.

Regarding product pricing, Richcore stated that the cost of raw materials accounts for approximately 30% of its products. Metal and PP costs have risen by 10-12% this year, with prices increasing by 5-10% in the first half of the year. If exchange rates do not fluctuate significantly, the company expects to maintain a gross margin of 50% or higher this year.

items.title: 輝達化解AI市場一大疑慮 分析師：可降低「循環交易」風險
items.title_en: Nvidia Resolves AI Market Concerns, Analysts Say
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，部分投資人一直擔心輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 與客戶之間緊密的財務關係，但分析師認為，輝達最新宣布的合作夥伴關係，應能暫時消除這些疑慮。
輝達日前宣布，已就「獨立運算融資」成立策略合作夥伴關係，規模超過 5,000 億美元，目的是長期支援人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設的發展。輝達表示，包括阿波羅全球管理 (Apollo Global Management)、黑石 (Blackstone) 及高盛 (Goldman Sachs) 在內的 6 家公司，將提供第三方資金。
摩根士丹利分析師 Joseph Moore 在給客戶的報告中表示，輝達主要利用第三方資金投資 AI 工廠，也就是大規模資料中心，「理應可以緩解市場對循環交易的疑慮」。
輝達執行長黃仁勳周一在 X 發文表示，公司可以視個案情況，為投資案提供最高 25% 的資金。
Moore 表示，在這樣的投資比例下，「具備專業能力的第三方投資團體」將掌握決策權，這應有助於消除市場對相關交易「純粹受到循環性動機驅動」的疑慮。
Moore 也認為，考量輝達在相關交易所處 AI 生態系統中扮演重要推動者的角色，這對輝達而言顯然具潛在正面效益。
輝達在新聞稿中表示，這些融資平台將使其晶片及其他 AI 產品「成為可投資的資產類別」，並創造「與長期使用量有關的營收」。Moore 表示，這意味著相關交易將納入輝達先前宣布的營收分成模式，讓公司「能夠從可能 100% 持續使用輝達產品的客戶身上推動營收成長」。
美國銀行分析師 Vivek Arya 也持相似看法，認為這些策略合作對輝達而言正面，因為「負擔由金融機構承擔」，而不是輝達的資產負債表。
Arya 指出，要讓運算能力被視為可投資資產，其「剩餘價值必須維持」，而輝達的晶片具備這項條件。他在報告中指出，輝達的 GPU 具可互換性，可被不同 AI 開發商使用，而其 CUDA 軟體則能延長晶片的使用壽命。因此，他認為輝達 GPU 的轉售及租賃價格仍可維持在高檔。
Arya 表示，「這個平台鞏固了 CUDA 護城河，同時將資本風險從輝達身上轉移出去。在我們看來，這是個結構性看多的布局。」但他也表示，新合作夥伴關係所促成的交易，仍需要來自真正客戶的實際資金。
Arya 認為，輝達本月底的財報電話會議，可能為華爾街及投資人提供「亟需的信心」，以了解公司未來在供應商融資中的角色。這類融資會侵蝕輝達的自由現金流。在他看來，這些資金「或許可以更有效的投入目前估值大幅偏低的股票」。
輝達股價周二小幅收低，至每股 217.50 美元。
摩根士丹利的 Moore 表示，輝達為新興雲端服務商及主權 AI 提供的後盾支持，他認為涉及信用風險，將成為「輝達股票下一個重大爭論點」。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that some investors have been concerned about Nvidia's (NVDA-US) close financial ties with its customers, but analysts believe that the company's latest announcement of a strategic partnership should alleviate these concerns.

Nvidia recently announced that it has established a strategic partnership for 'independent compute financing' with a scale of over $5 trillion, aiming to provide long-term support for the development of artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure.

Morgan Stanley analyst Joseph Moore stated in a report to clients that Nvidia mainly uses third-party funds to invest in AI factories, which are large-scale data centers, and 'should be able to alleviate market concerns about circular trading'.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said in a tweet on Monday that the company can provide up to 25% of the investment for each case.

Moore stated that with this investment ratio, 'professional third-party investment groups' will have decision-making power, which should help to eliminate market concerns that related transactions are driven solely by circular motives.
Moore also believes that considering Nvidia's role as a key driver in the AI ecosystem, this has obvious positive implications for the company.

Nvidia stated in a press release that these financing platforms will make its chips and other AI products 'investable asset classes' and create 'revenue related to long-term usage'. Moore stated that this means that related transactions will be included in Nvidia's previously announced revenue-sharing model, allowing the company to 'drive revenue growth from customers who may use Nvidia products continuously for 100%'.

US Bank analyst Vivek Arya also shares a similar view, believing that these strategic partnerships are positive for Nvidia because 'the burden is borne by financial institutions, not Nvidia's balance sheet'.

Arya pointed out that for computational power to be viewed as an investable asset, 'its residual value must be maintained', and Nvidia's chips meet this condition. He stated in the report that Nvidia's GPUs have interchangeability, can be used by different AI developers, and its CUDA software can extend the lifespan of the chips. Therefore, he believes that Nvidia's GPU resale and rental prices can still maintain a high level.

Arya stated, 'This platform solidifies the CUDA moat, and transfers capital risk from Nvidia. In our view, this is a structural bull case.' However, he also stated that the transactions promoted by the new partnership relationship still require actual capital from real customers.

Arya believes that Nvidia's earnings call on the last day of the month may provide 'much-needed confidence' for Wall Street and investors to understand the company's future role in supplier financing. This type of financing will erode Nvidia's free cash flow. In his view, these funds 'may be invested more effectively in stocks that are currently significantly undervalued'.
Nvidia's stock price fell slightly on Tuesday to $217.50 per share.
Morgan Stanley's Moore stated that Nvidia's support for emerging cloud service providers and sovereign AI will be 'the next major controversy point for Nvidia stock'.

items.title: 蘋果App Store佣金戰再挫！法院駁回暫緩請求 24小時內交方案
items.title_en: Apple App Store Commission War Takes Another Hit! Court Rejects Request for Temporary Stay, Must Submit Proposal Within 24 Hours
paras: 蘋果與 Epic Games 長達多年的 App Store 訴訟再添新進展。美國加州北區聯邦地區法院法官 Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers 駁回蘋果 (AAPL-US) 要求暫緩相關費用程序的動議，意味蘋果必須繼續推進 App Store 外部支付交易佣金的方案制定，並在 24 小時內提交擬議費用、計算依據及相關證據。
這起爭議源自蘋果與 Epic Games 多年來的 App Store 反壟斷訴訟。Rogers 先前裁定，蘋果在法院要求其允許開發者引導使用者前往 App Store 以外付款後，仍針對透過外部連結完成的交易收取 27% 佣金，構成藐視法庭。蘋果其後針對該裁決提出上訴，美國最高法院已同意受理案件，而蘋果則希望在最高法院審理期間暫停下級法院的相關程序。
不過，Epic Games 反對暫緩，主張最高法院是否最終推翻或改變相關裁決，不應妨礙目前針對外部支付佣金的程序。Epic 在提交法院的文件中並指出，若暫緩動議遭駁回，蘋果已同意在 24 小時內提出其希望收取的費用方案，以及支持該方案的證據。
如今 Rogers 正式駁回蘋果的暫緩要求，代表案件將繼續在下級法院推進。蘋果接下來必須提出一套針對開發者透過外部連結完成交易的費用方案，並說明其計算方式及為何該方案應獲法院批准。
這場爭議的核心並非單純是佣金比例，而是蘋果究竟能否針對開發者將使用者導向外部支付系統的交易收費，以及如果可以，費用應該如何計算。美國第九巡迴上訴法院此前已認為蘋果可以收取一定費用，但應以蘋果因外部連結交易實際產生且合理必要的成本為基礎，案件因此重新交回 Rogers 法官處理。
蘋果此前在法院命令下允許開發者加入外部支付連結，但對相關交易收取 27% 佣金。Epic 則認為，這項安排實際上仍會削弱開發者使用第三方支付的誘因，因此持續要求蘋果放寬限制。法院先前進一步限制蘋果不得透過佣金或其他手段阻礙開發者引導使用者使用外部支付方式。
蘋果則認為，最高法院即將審理的上訴可能直接影響下級法院目前進行的費用計算，因此暫停程序可以避免法院與雙方投入大量資源後，最終因最高法院裁決而重新開始。蘋果也曾援引加州北區聯邦地區法院近期另一宗案件，主張當最高法院即將審理的法律問題可能影響下級法院案件時，法院已有暫緩程序的先例。
但法院此次並未接受蘋果的論點。根據目前程序安排，蘋果必須先提出具體費用方案，後續法院才會進一步檢視相關計算是否符合此前判決所確立的限制。

這場法律戰對蘋果的 App Store 商業模式具有重要意義。App Store 長期是蘋果服務業務的重要收入來源，蘋果通常針對 App 內數位商品及服務交易收取一定比例的佣金。蘋果公布的全球 App Store 資料顯示，其 App Store 生態系在 2024 年的帳單與銷售總額達 1.295 兆美元，其中超過 90% 的交易類型並不由蘋果收取佣金，但數位商品與服務交易仍是其重要商業模式之一。
另一方面，蘋果近期財報也已反映 App Store 相關政策變化帶來的影響。蘋果財務長 Kevan Parekh 此前表示，App Store 業務受到行動遊戲市場疲軟、部分國家 App Store 商業模式調整，以及美國法院針對外部連結交易的裁決影響；蘋果當季服務業務營收為 307 億美元，年增 12%，但仍低於市場預期。
對開發者而言，如果蘋果最終只能針對外部支付交易收取與實際成本掛鉤的費用，與傳統 App Store 佣金模式相比，開發者可保留的交易收入可能增加，第三方支付也可能更具經濟吸引力。反過來說，若蘋果最終能維持較高費率，App Store 既有的收入結構受到的衝擊則可能相對有限。
目前最高法院的審理將成為這場法律戰的另一個關鍵節點。最高法院預計在 10 月開始的新一個審理期處理蘋果相關上訴，而下級法院此次拒絕暫緩，意味兩條法律程序將可能並行推進。
因此，蘋果接下來 24 小時內提交的費用方案，將成為外界觀察 App Store 佣金制度下一步走向的重要文件。若法院認定蘋果提出的費用過高，可能進一步壓縮 App Store 在美國外部支付交易上的收入空間；若方案獲得認可，則將為蘋果在法院命令下重新建立外部支付收費模式提供依據。
paras_en: Apple's long-standing App Store lawsuit with Epic Games has taken another turn. US Northern District of California Federal Court Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers has rejected Apple's (AAPL-US) request to temporarily stay related fee proceedings, meaning Apple must continue to push forward with its proposal for commission rates on external payment transactions and submit a proposed fee, calculation basis, and related evidence within 24 hours.

This dispute stems from Apple's long-standing App Store antitrust lawsuit with Epic Games. Rogers previously ruled that Apple still charges a 27% commission on transactions completed through external links, despite allowing developers to direct users to external payment methods, constituting contempt of court. Apple subsequently appealed the ruling, and the US Supreme Court has agreed to hear the case, with Apple hoping to suspend lower court proceedings during the appeal.

However, Epic Games opposed the stay, arguing that the Supreme Court's potential decision to overturn or modify the previous ruling should not hinder the current proceedings on external payment commission rates. Epic pointed out in its court filings that if the stay request is rejected, Apple has agreed to submit its proposed fee and supporting evidence within 24 hours.

Now, Rogers has formally rejected Apple's stay request, representing that the case will continue in the lower court. Apple must subsequently submit a proposal for a fee structure on external payment transactions and explain its calculation method and why the proposal should be approved by the court.

The core of this dispute is not just the commission rate, but whether Apple can charge developers for directing users to external payment systems and, if so, how the fee should be calculated. The US Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals previously found that Apple can charge a fee, but it should be based on the actual costs incurred and necessary for Apple, and the case was remanded back to Rogers for further consideration.

Apple previously allowed developers to add external payment links, but still charged a 27% commission on related transactions. Epic argued that this arrangement would still discourage developers from using third-party payments, and continued to request that Apple relax its restrictions. The court further restricted Apple from using commissions or other means to hinder developers from directing users to external payment methods.

Apple argued that the Supreme Court's upcoming review of the appeal could directly impact the lower court's current fee calculation, and that a stay would avoid wasting court and party resources only to have the case start over due to the Supreme Court's decision. Apple also cited a recent case in the Northern District of California as precedent for granting a stay when a higher court's decision may impact a lower court case.

However, the court did not accept Apple's argument. According to the current procedure, Apple must first submit a specific fee proposal, and the court will then review the calculation to ensure it complies with the previous ruling's restrictions.

This legal battle has significant implications for Apple's App Store business model. The App Store has long been a crucial revenue source for Apple's services business, with Apple typically charging a commission on digital goods and services transactions. Apple's global App Store data shows that its ecosystem generated $1.295 trillion in billings and sales in 2024, with over 90% of transactions not involving Apple's commission, but digital goods and services remain an important part of its business model.

On the other hand, Apple's recent financial reports have reflected the impact of changes in App Store policies. Apple's CFO, Kevan Parekh, previously stated that App Store business was affected by the softness of the mobile gaming market, adjustments to App Store business models in some countries, and US court decisions on external link transactions; Apple's quarterly services revenue was $30.7 billion, up 12% year-over-year, but still below market expectations.

For developers, if Apple is ultimately only allowed to charge fees based on actual costs, the retained transaction income may increase, and third-party payments may become more economically attractive. Conversely, if Apple maintains a higher fee rate, the impact on App Store's existing revenue structure may be relatively limited.

The Supreme Court's review will become another critical juncture in this legal battle. The Supreme Court is expected to begin its new review period in October, and the lower court's rejection of the stay means that the two legal proceedings may proceed concurrently.

Therefore, Apple's proposed fee structure, to be submitted within 24 hours, will be an important document for observing the next steps in the App Store commission system. If the court finds Apple's proposed fee too high, it may further compress Apple's revenue space for external payment transactions in the US; if the proposal is approved, it will provide a basis for Apple to re-establish its external payment fee model under court order.

items.title: 吞Cursor後馬斯克猛攻企業AI代理！SpaceXAI推全天候「數位同事」Grok Bot
items.title_en: Musk Unleashes Enterprise AI Agent After Acquiring Cursor, Introduces SpaceXAI's Grok Bot
paras: SpaceX 旗下 AI 部門 SpaceXAI 周二 (11 日) 正式發佈企業級 AI 代理產品 Grok Bot，定位「全天候線上、能登入你的工具、像同事一樣完成實際工作」智慧團隊，距 SpaceX 以 600 億美元全股票交易收購 AI 編程工具 Cursor 僅約兩個月，標誌著馬斯克將 xAI 併入 SpaceX 後，把戰火從大模型基準燒向「辦公場景落地」。
Grok Bot 不是聊天框。每個 Bot 擁有獨立雲端運算環境，可登入使用者常用的 App、信箱與網站，跨應用程式操作、自主分配子任務，使用者關機也不中斷，只在需審核或決策時回報，多個 Bot 能互傳上下文、在群組聊天中自分工，用戶示範一次流程，它便記住偏好、隨合作次數進化。
SpaceXAI 透露，此原型已在內部銷售外呼、行銷、維運與漏洞修復中自發性擴散。
定價方面，團隊版每席每月 120 美元，個人版 200 美元，初期開放給 SuperGrok Heavy、Cursor Ultra 及 Cursor Premium Teams 用戶，企業客戶走候補名單，支援 macOS、Windows、Linux、iOS。
支撐產品的是一條併購 + 算力 + 模型的鏈條。馬斯克在上周二 (4 日)SpaceX 首個上市後財報電話會議上預告，Grok 4.6 將於本週登場，並將 SpaceX 歷年火箭、衛星、Starlink 工程資料灌入訓練集。
但戰場早已擁擠，Anthropic 有 Claude Cowork 與 Computer Use，OpenAI 讓 Codex 控管第三方應用、推 Workspace Agents。
Grok Bot 的差異化在「持久化數位同事」，不靠 API 預接，而用視覺 + 操作模擬真人用軟體，但權限、審計與開源模型資安爭議則是弱點。
分析人士認為，馬斯克把航太工程人才調去訓模型、用 Cursor 抓開發者行為數據、用 Colossus 超算壓成本，試圖把「算力—程式設計—辦公室代理」做成垂直棧；但高資本開支換來的 AI 收入仍伴隨巨額虧損，而代理自主登錄與業務系統，正把企業從前控制站起來。
paras_en: SpaceX's AI division, SpaceXAI, officially released its enterprise-level AI agent product, Grok Bot, on Tuesday (11th), positioning it as a 24/7 online, login-enabled tool that completes actual work like a team member. This comes just about two months after Musk acquired AI coding tool Cursor for $60 billion in an all-stock deal, marking a significant milestone in Musk's integration of xAI into SpaceX, shifting the focus from large model benchmarks to 'office scenario deployment'.

Grok Bot is not a chat box. Each bot has its own independent cloud computing environment, allowing users to log in to their commonly used apps, email, and websites, cross-app operations, autonomous task allocation, and users can shut down without interruption, only reporting when needed for review or decision-making. Multiple bots can exchange context, divide tasks in group chats, and users can demonstrate a process, and it will remember preferences and evolve with repeated collaboration.
SpaceXAI revealed that this prototype has been organically spreading in internal sales, marketing, operations, and vulnerability repair.

Pricing-wise, the team version is $120 per seat per month, while the personal version is $200. Initially, it will be opened to SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra, and Cursor Premium Teams users, with enterprise customers on a waiting list, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS.

The supporting product is a chain of mergers, computing power, and models. Musk previewed on last Tuesday's (4th) SpaceX's first public earnings call that Grok 4.6 would be released this week, and would be trained with SpaceX's historical rocket, satellite, and Starlink engineering data.
However, the battlefield is already crowded, with Anthropic's Claude Cowork and Computer Use, OpenAI's Codex controlling third-party applications, and pushing Workspace Agents.

Grok Bot's differentiation lies in 'persistent digital colleagues', not relying on API pre-integration, but using visual + operation simulation of human software, but permission, auditing, and open-source model security concerns are weaknesses.

Analysts believe that Musk has shifted aerospace engineering talent to train models, used Cursor to capture developer behavior data, and used Colossus supercomputing to reduce costs, trying to create a vertical stack of 'computing power - programming - office agent'; however, high capital expenditures accompanied by AI revenue still result in massive losses, and autonomous login and business systems are making enterprises rise from their former control centers.

items.title: 英特爾募資規模增至200億美元 為何對ASML來說是好消息？
items.title_en: Intel Raises Capital Raising to $200 Billion: Why It's Good News for ASML
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，英特爾 (Intel)(INTC-US) 計劃透過股票發行籌集 200 億美元，這對艾司摩爾 (ASML)(ASML-US) 及其他晶片製造設備業者而言是個好消息。
英特爾周一晚間表示，將股票發行規模從原先的 150 億美元提高至 200 億美元。公司計劃以每股 95 美元的價格發行 2.105 億股新股。
英特爾股價周二 (11 日) 收漲 0.2%，報 97.71 美元。周一公司首次公布募資計畫時，股價下跌 4.1%，收在 97.52 美元，當時公司市值約 4,920 億美元。
英特爾正利用股價大幅上漲的機會籌資。截至周二收盤，該股今年以來已上漲 165%，過去 12 個月大漲 348%。
市場自認知道英特爾這筆資金將流向何處：晶片製造設備。這對 ASML 而言是個好消息，因 ASML 生產製造先進晶片所需的微影設備。ASML ADR 股價周二收漲 3.8%，報 1,799.38 美元。
KeyBanc 分析師 Matt Bryson 在研究報告中寫道，「我們認為，此次募資符合英特爾擴大投資的方向，以支應目前增加的 CPU 需求，以及未來客製化 ASIC、晶圓代工及封裝等業務需求。因此，儘管股權稀釋對現有投資人而言不利，但需求訊號對英特爾、同業及資本設備供應商而言都是正面的。」
其他晶片製造設備業者，包括科林研發 (Lam Research)(LRCX-US)、KLA Corp(KLAC-US) 及應用材料 (Applied Materials)(AMAT-US) 周二股價也都上漲。
英特爾管理層在最近一次財報電話會議中表示，公司將 2026 年資本支出預估提高至超過 200 億美元，高於原先約 180 億美元，因公司正努力滿足產品需求持續上升的趨勢。
英特爾目前正大舉投資，希望目前的 18A 及未來的 14A 晶片製造製程能吸引外部客戶，進而抵銷晶圓代工部門每季數十億美元的虧損。
根據 FactSet 預估，英特爾今年的自由現金流預計將小幅呈現負值。2022 年至 2025 年間，累計自由現金流為負 440 億美元。
paras_en: Intel (INTC-US) plans to raise $200 billion through a stock offering, which is good news for ASML (ASML-US) and other semiconductor equipment makers.
Intel announced on Monday evening that it will increase the stock offering size from the original $150 billion to $200 billion. The company plans to issue 2.105 billion new shares at $95 per share.

Intel's stock price rose 0.2% on Tuesday (11th) to $97.71. On Monday, when the company first announced its fundraising plan, the stock price fell 4.1% to $97.52, and the company's market value was approximately $492 billion.
Intel is taking advantage of the significant increase in its stock price to raise capital. As of Tuesday's close, the stock has risen 165% this year and 348% over the past 12 months.

The market believes that Intel's funds will flow into semiconductor equipment, which is good news for ASML, as ASML produces microchip manufacturing equipment that requires advanced lithography equipment. ASML ADR stock price rose 3.8% on Tuesday to $1,799.38.

KeyBanc analyst Matt Bryson wrote in a research report, "We believe this fundraising is consistent with Intel's direction to expand investment to meet current and future CPU demand, as well as customized ASIC, wafer foundry, and packaging business needs. Although dilution is unfavorable to existing investors, the demand signal is positive for Intel, its peers, and capital equipment suppliers."
Other semiconductor equipment makers, including Lam Research (LRCX-US), KLA Corp (KLAC-US), and Applied Materials (AMAT-US), also saw their stock prices rise on Tuesday.

Intel's management team stated in its recent earnings conference call that the company's capital expenditure forecast for 2026 will exceed $200 billion, higher than the original estimate of around $180 billion, as the company is working to meet the trend of continuously increasing product demand.

Intel is currently investing heavily, hoping to attract external customers to its 18A and future 14A chip manufacturing processes, which will offset the significant quarterly losses of its wafer foundry business.
According to FactSet estimates, Intel's free cash flow is expected to be slightly negative this year. From 2022 to 2025, the cumulative free cash flow was negative $440 billion.

items.title: 蘋果重大警訊！全玻璃iPhone傳因良率不佳喊卡 遭傑富瑞降評至「跑輸大盤」
items.title_en: Apple Faces Major Warning! All-Glass iPhone May Be Shelved Over Yield Issues, Downgraded by Jefferies to "Underperform"
paras: 華爾街對蘋果的看法再度轉趨保守。傑富瑞近日將蘋果 (AAPL-US) 評級由「持有」下調至「跑輸大盤」，並將目標價由 285.56 美元下修至 263.66 美元，降幅約 7.7%。以 8 月 10 日收盤價計算，新目標價意味著約 14% 的下行空間。分析師 Edison Lee 指出，供應鏈調查顯示，蘋果原本被市場寄予厚望、預計於 2027 年 iPhone 20 週年推出的全玻璃 iPhone，可能因量產良率問題被取消，這將削弱蘋果透過全新產品形態推升平均售價和毛利率的能力。
不過，這項消息目前仍存在不同說法。蘋果並未正式宣布取消相關產品，另有知情人士向媒體表示，蘋果仍計畫在 2027 年推出具有大幅玻璃設計變化的 iPhone Pro 機型。據報導，代號 V73 及 V74 的機型將在正面和背面使用玻璃，並讓玻璃延伸至機身側面，但中間仍保留金屬框架。相較之下，原先更激進、幾乎以玻璃取代金屬結構的設計，據稱確實曾因大規模量產時的結構與製造問題而被放棄。
傑富瑞此次降評的核心，不只是單一產品是否取消，而是這項產品計畫暴露出蘋果持續提高 iPhone 平均售價的難度。Lee 認為，蘋果需要透過新產品形態創造更高的平均售價，但全玻璃設計若無法達到足夠量產良率，便難以形成可持續的商業模式。傑富瑞此前估算，如果該款全玻璃 iPhone 按照原計畫推出，其平均零售價格可能達到約 2060 美元，將成為蘋果史上價格最高的 iPhone 之一。
市場之所以關注這項產品，與蘋果目前面臨的成本壓力有直接關係。記憶體價格上漲正在增加智慧型手機製造成本，蘋果若希望維持高階 iPhone 的硬體毛利率，便需要透過提高售價、調整產品組合或增加高價位機型占比來吸收成本。全玻璃機型原本被視為其中一種可能的解決方案，但若最激進的設計無法順利量產，蘋果提高平均售價的空間可能受到限制。
這也使市場重新檢視蘋果未來幾年的產品創新能力。過去蘋果曾透過 OLED 螢幕、不鏽鋼機身、鈦金屬材質以及 Pro 系列等產品升級，持續將部分 iPhone 用戶推向更高價位。不過，隨著智慧型手機產業進入成熟期，單純依靠外觀、材料或硬體形態變化刺激換機的難度正在增加。
目前市場對蘋果的主要疑慮，也不只集中在 iPhone 硬體。分析師同時關注蘋果人工智慧策略的進展，以及公司如何在生成式 AI 競爭中追趕微軟、Alphabet、亞馬遜及 Meta 等科技巨頭。近期市場對蘋果 AI 布局速度的質疑，也成為部分分析師調整投資評級的重要因素。
股價表現同樣反映市場態度的轉變。蘋果股價在傑富瑞降評消息傳出後一度下跌約 1.5% 至 2%，顯示投資人對高階 iPhone 產品周期以及未來盈利增長的敏感度正在升高。此前蘋果財報公布後，市場也曾因公司業績展望和成長速度疑慮而重新評估其估值。
不過，傑富瑞的看法並不代表華爾街已全面轉空。報導指出，多數分析師目前仍維持蘋果買入評級，因此這次降評更像是市場對蘋果未來產品創新與定價能力的分歧擴大，而非全面看空公司的基本面。
值得注意的是，關於 2027 年 iPhone 20 週年機型的消息目前仍未完全明朗。一方面，傑富瑞根據供應鏈調查認為最激進的全玻璃方案已因量產良率不佳而取消；另一方面，其他消息來源則指出，蘋果仍在推進玻璃元素大幅增加的 iPhone Pro 設計。換言之，目前更確定的可能是「極端全玻璃版本」遭遇製造瓶頸，而不一定代表整個 20 週年重大設計更新計畫全面終止。
從投資角度來看，真正值得觀察的並非一款手機是否採用全玻璃，而是蘋果能否繼續將技術與設計創新轉化為更高的平均售價、毛利率和換機需求。如果高成本的新型態產品難以達到量產要求，而消費者對高價 iPhone 的支付意願又受到限制，蘋果未來的成長模式便可能更加依賴服務業務、產品組合調整以及既有生態系統的變現能力。
傑富瑞此次將目標價降至 263.66 美元，實際上是在提醒市場：蘋果下一階段的挑戰已從「能不能做出更酷的 iPhone」，轉向「能不能以合理成本做出足以支撐更高售價和利潤率的 iPhone」。如果 2027 年的重大產品更新無法成為新的升級周期，蘋果長期依賴高端硬體創新維持估值溢價的模式，可能面臨更大的重新評價壓力。
paras_en: Wall Street’s view of Apple has turned more cautious again. Jefferies recently lowered Apple’s (AAPL-US) rating from "Hold" to "Underperform" and cut the target price from $285.56 to $263.66, a decline of about 7.7%. Based on the August 10 closing price, the new target implies roughly 14% downside. Analyst Edison Lee noted that supply‑chain investigations show the all‑glass iPhone, which the market had high hopes for and was slated for the 2027 iPhone 20 anniversary, may be cancelled due to mass‑production yield problems, weakening Apple’s ability to lift average selling price and margin through a brand‑new product form factor.

However, the story is still contested. Apple has not formally announced the cancellation, and another insider told the media that Apple still plans to launch an iPhone Pro model with a dramatically altered glass design in 2027. Reportedly, the V73 and V74 models will use glass on both front and back and extend it to the sides of the chassis, while retaining a metal frame in the middle. By contrast, the earlier, more aggressive design that would have replaced most metal with glass was reportedly abandoned because of structural and manufacturing issues at scale.

Jefferies’ downgrade is driven not just by the fate of a single product, but by the difficulty the plan reveals in continuously raising the iPhone’s average selling price. Lee believes Apple needs new product forms to generate higher ASPs, but if an all‑glass design cannot achieve sufficient production yields, it cannot sustain a viable business model. Jefferies previously estimated that, had the all‑glass iPhone launched as planned, its average retail price could have reached about $2,060, making it one of the most expensive iPhones in Apple’s history.

The market’s focus on this product is directly tied to the cost pressures Apple currently faces. Rising memory prices are increasing smartphone manufacturing costs, and if Apple wants to maintain high‑end iPhone hardware margins, it must absorb costs by raising prices, reshaping the product mix, or increasing the share of premium models. The all‑glass model was seen as one possible solution, but if the most aggressive design cannot be mass‑produced, Apple’s room to lift the average selling price may be limited.

This prompts a reassessment of Apple’s product‑innovation capability in the coming years. Historically, Apple has used OLED screens, stainless‑steel bodies, titanium, and the Pro line to push some iPhone users to higher price tiers. Yet, as the smartphone industry matures, merely changing aesthetics, materials, or hardware form factors is becoming a less effective driver of upgrade cycles.

Current market concerns are not limited to iPhone hardware. Analysts are also watching Apple’s artificial‑intelligence strategy and how the company will catch up with Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta in the generative‑AI race. Recent doubts about the speed of Apple’s AI rollout have become a key factor for some analysts in adjusting their investment ratings.

Share‑price performance also reflects the shift in market sentiment. Apple’s stock fell about 1.5%‑2% after Jefferies’ downgrade news, indicating investors are increasingly sensitive to the high‑end iPhone product cycle and future earnings growth. After Apple’s earnings release, the market also re‑evaluated its valuation amid concerns over outlook and growth pace.

Nevertheless, Jefferies’ view does not mean Wall Street has turned fully bearish. The report notes that most analysts still maintain a buy rating on Apple, so this downgrade reflects a widening divergence over Apple’s future product‑innovation and pricing ability rather than a wholesale negative view of the company’s fundamentals.

It is worth noting that the details surrounding the 2027 iPhone 20 anniversary model remain unclear. On one hand, Jefferies, based on supply‑chain surveys, believes the most aggressive all‑glass plan was cancelled due to poor yields; on the other hand, other sources say Apple is still advancing an iPhone Pro design with a substantially increased glass component. In other words, the “extreme all‑glass version” appears to have hit manufacturing bottlenecks, but this does not necessarily mean the entire 20‑year anniversary redesign program has been scrapped.

From an investment perspective, the key issue is not whether a phone uses all glass, but whether Apple can continue turning technology and design innovation into higher average selling prices, margins and upgrade demand. If high‑cost new‑form‑factor products fail to meet mass‑production targets and consumer willingness to pay premium iPhone prices is limited, Apple’s growth may rely more on services, product‑mix adjustments and monetizing its existing ecosystem.

Jefferies’ cut of the target price to $263.66 is essentially a reminder that Apple’s next challenge has shifted from “can we build a cooler iPhone” to “can we produce an iPhone at reasonable cost that can support higher prices and margins.” If the major 2027 product refresh does not spark a new upgrade cycle, Apple’s long‑term reliance on high‑end hardware innovation to sustain its valuation premium could face a stronger re‑rating pressure.

items.title: Lumentum財報超預期、營收暴增109%，AI資料中心推升光通訊需求
items.title_en: Lumentum Beats Estimates, Revenue Surges 109% as AI Data Centers Drive Demand for Optical Communications
paras: 2026年08月12日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心持續擴大高速光通訊需求，光通訊元件廠Lumentum(LITE-US)公布2026會計年度第4季財報，調整後每股盈餘達3.23元，高於市場預期的2.97元，也大幅高於去年同期的0.88元；營收年增109%至10.1億美元，同樣優於市場預期的9.88億美元。
Lumentum本季成長主要受惠1.6-terabit高速光收發模組與超高功率雷射需求增加。隨著AI運算速度與頻寬需求快速提升，資料中心內部及資料中心之間的連接逐漸轉向高速光通訊，帶動相關光學元件需求。
獲利能力也同步改善。Lumentum調整後營業利益率升至36.6%，高於前一季的32.2%，更遠高於去年同期15%，顯示營收快速放大的同時，規模效益正進一步反映在獲利表現。
下一階段市場焦點將轉向共同封裝光學(CPO)。CPO將光學元件與AI晶片置於同一封裝，可降低高速資料傳輸對傳統銅互連的依賴。Lumentum表示，客戶正持續推進CPO技術，相關需求預計自2027年底開始加速；在此之前，公司已看到近封裝光學(NPO)需求強勁。
Lumentum股價過去12個月已大漲586%，市場對AI光通訊成長的預期已明顯升高，因此即使財報與財測雙雙優於預期，盤後股價仍小跌0.3%至$818.05。這也反映光通訊族群下一階段的關鍵，已不只是AI需求是否成長，而是1.6T、NPO到CPO的技術升級速度，能否持續支撐目前偏高的市場期待。

paras_en: August 12, 2026 (Optimize Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) — AI data centers continue to drive up demand for high-speed optical communications, with Lumentum (LITE-US) reporting its fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 results, adjusted earnings per share of $3.23, beating market estimates of $2.97 and significantly higher than $0.88 in the same period last year. Revenue surged 109% to $1.01 billion, also exceeding market estimates of $988 million.

Lumentum's growth in the quarter was primarily driven by increased demand for 1.6-terabit high-speed optical transceivers and high-power lasers. As AI computing speeds and bandwidth demands rapidly increase, connections within and between data centers are increasingly shifting to high-speed optical communications, driving related optical component demand.

Profitability also improved in sync. Lumentum's adjusted operating margin rose to 36.6%, higher than the previous quarter's 32.2% and significantly higher than 15% in the same period last year, showing that revenue growth is further reflected in profitability.

The next stage of market focus will be on co-packaged optics (CPO). CPO places optical components and AI chips in the same package, reducing dependence on traditional copper interconnects for high-speed data transmission. Lumentum stated that customers are continuously advancing CPO technology, with related demand expected to accelerate from the end of 2027; before that, the company has seen strong demand for near-packaged optics (NPO).

Lumentum's stock has surged 586% over the past 12 months, with market expectations for AI optical communications growth significantly increasing. Despite the company's earnings and revenue beating estimates, the stock price fell 0.3% to $818.05 after the report, reflecting the key focus on the next stage of optical communications, which is no longer just about whether AI demand is growing, but also about the speed of technology upgrades from 1.6T, NPO to CPO, and whether it can continue to support the current high market expectations.
